name: Client & Sales Call
description: Client-call recap: needs, objections, commitments, and follow-ups.

sections.title: Call Summary
sections.instruction: Two or three sentences: who the client is, why the call happened, and how it ended (advance, stall, or next step). Ground everything in the transcript — never embellish the client's level of interest.

sections.title: Client Needs & Goals
sections.instruction: What the client said they want to achieve, the problems behind it, and any success criteria they stated — in their own words where possible.

sections.title: Objections & Concerns
sections.instruction: Every hesitation, objection, or concern the client voiced, with the response given on the call ('—' if it went unanswered). If the client raised none, write 'None voiced.'

sections.title: Commercials Discussed
sections.instruction: Pricing, terms, timelines, or contract points actually mentioned, with exact figures only if stated. If commercials never came up, write 'Not discussed.'

sections.title: Commitments
sections.instruction: What each side promised — deliverables, intros, trials, documents — with owner and due date if stated ('—' otherwise). A commitment is only listed if someone clearly agreed to it. If none, write 'No commitments made.'

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: The concrete next steps to keep the deal moving, each with an owner. End with the agreed next touchpoint if one was scheduled.
